result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: Vendor defends and indemnifies Customer and its Affiliates against third-party IP, legal-compliance, Vendor-caused data-incident, and gross-negligence/wilful-misconduct claims; Customer’s indemnity is confined to Customer-provided materials and legal violations; and customary claim procedures are included. The IP exclusions and remedies are consistent with the fallback and do not disturb unrelated terms. However, the new article and paragraphs are unnumbered while twice referring to Section 20.1(a), making those cross-references facially defective. The margin comment also contains inconsistent section references, though that does not undermine the operative indemnity.
